title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 20 April 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 19 April 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at most places of the island after 1.00 pm. Fairly heavy falls above 75 mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and North- central provinces and in Kurunegala, Galle and Matara districts. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
